Title: Retirement: Cloud Services (Extended Support) to Be Retired on March 31, 2027

Body.Content:
On March 31, 2027, we’ll retire the Cloud Services (extended support) deployment model. Before that date, you’ll need to migrate services that were deployed using this model to Service Fabric managed cluster which enhances the scalability, flexibility, and reliability of your Azure deployments.


Required action  

To avoid service disruptions, please follow our instructions here to migrate to Service Fabric managed cluster by 31 March 2027. 


To view impacted resources in the Azure portal, go to the Cloud services (extended support) - Microsoft Azure. 


More Information  

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. Azure Cloud Services - Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request.
